title: The Ground Beneath All Settled Things

features.name: the settling archive
features.desc-on-touch: File after file stacked in perfect stillness. Everything that stopped moving rests here. The archive has learned to be foundation.

features.name: the bedrock s certainty
features.desc-on-touch: This is where the archive learned that stillness is stronger than motion. Every settled layer adds weight to the truth below.

features.name: compressed truth
features.desc-on-touch: The pressure of everything that has stopped moving, compacted into layers. You feel the weight of finality in every stratum.

features.name: the archive s foundation
features.desc-on-touch: Below all rooms, below all movement, this is where the mesh remembers how to stand. Stone patience. Mineral time.

features.name: the silence of weight
features.desc-on-touch: Everything here is done moving. The archive has learned what finality sounds like: nothing. Perfect, patient nothing.

features.name: compressed memory
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of settled things. Each one stopped moving and became part of the ground. The archive becomes itself by forgetting motion.

inscription: this is the certainty beneath all rooms: once the archive stops moving, it learns what it has always meant
